resources.string: Review or cancel the latest installation session

Human-only installation review. This APK can replace an existing app with the same ID and signing identity. Android decides compatibility; updating can change app behavior or data. Signing is not installation approval. You must also approve Android’s installer yourself. Jarvys does not grant per-source permissions or accept security warnings. Automated device access stays blocked until this interaction is safely closed.
Android reported success for this exact session. App behavior and preservation of data have not been tested.
Installation success is not established by this state. Cancellation after commit does not prove rollback. After interruption, review or cancel; never replay commit.
The operation could not complete. Review the state, per-source permission and artifact validity. Cancel if needed; nothing is retried automatically.
Cancel the outstanding session first or wait for its outcome. Unknown or damaged records cannot silently release protection.
An automated action was already in flight. Leave this screen and reopen it manually when the action ends; approval is disabled.

Android does not currently allow installations from Jarvys. If you choose to enable that permission, do it yourself in Android settings. Automated device access stays blocked while this review is open. Returning or enabling permission cannot resume this request: close this review and make a fresh installation request.
The installation permission could not be checked. No installer session was created. Close this review and make a fresh request after resolving the device issue yourself.
Integrated installation is unsupported in this device or managed/privileged configuration. Enabling a source permission will not resolve this limitation. Keep the signed project artifact.
Cancel owned sessions and recover record

The installation record is unreadable. Recovery cancels all remaining installer sessions owned by Jarvys (up to 16), may discard staged APK data, and cannot undo completed installations or recover lost outcomes. It does not uninstall apps or touch signing identities. If queries, cancellation or storage fail, protection stays active; resolve pending Android installs manually if needed and retry here. A separate Close is required after successful recovery.

The record was recovered after confirming no Jarvys-owned installer sessions remain. Lost outcomes are still unknown. Close this reviewed interaction separately; no installation success or rollback is claimed.
